context: M24 o5. Villalba on the dispatch radio, too calm. Augie listening.

lines.speaker: char.hector_villalba
lines.text: Unit one, unit one. Mr. Lisle's office calling for Mr. Varelas. Urgent.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: How does Lisle know you're here? Hector. Hector, how does he know?

lines.speaker: char.hector_villalba
lines.text: Augie thinks it's his. Lisle thinks it's his. The trucks know whose it is.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Your man sold you before you could sell yourself, Augie. Go home. See a doctor.
